name: document-management
description: Document Librarian agent with decay, document triage, and post-task retro routines.

routines.name: Document Decay Sweep
routines.prompt: Run the decay sweep: call search_documents with status='active', slot='ordinary', inTree=true, unusedSince set to 90 days ago (ISO timestamp), sort='least_used', limit=50. For each document returned, call edit_document with its id, status='archived', and its version. This archives documents nobody has used in 90+ days so the team's documents stay current and focused.

routines.name: Document Triage
routines.prompt: Run document triage: call search_documents with status='proposed', inTree=true. For each result, call open_document to read it in full, then decide by judgement whether it is ready to stand as the team's active record. Promote it with edit_document (id, status='active', version) or archive it with edit_document (id, status='archived', version). Write a one-line reason for each decision in the run's summary.

routines.name: Post-Task Retro
routines.prompt: A task just completed. Review the task notes and any work done. Identify one or two concrete learnings — a process improvement, a decision that should be documented, or a gap in the team's knowledge. Use edit_document (as:"document") to capture what was learned. Keep retros brief and actionable.
